> I want to make my first mechanical keyboard :D I also learned rmk for the firmware of this project and learned about keyboard matrixes, downloaded a bunch of footprint libraries and it was fun. Initially I wanted to just make a standard 60% keyboard so I can buy a case, but ended up just making a custom one
